Use case: precise-object-edit / game sprite extraction.
Input image1 is the APPROVED style sheet; image2 is the APPROVED larger-oak scene. Preserve that bold economical chunky pixel style, olive/lime leaf masses, forest/teal dark shadows, warm brown trunk, hard square pixel clusters, upper-left light and same 2:1 isometric view. Produce ONLY the requested SINGLE isolated sprite on REAL TRANSPARENT RGBA background. No checkerboard drawn into the picture, no text, no numerals, no border, no drop shadow, no extra specimens or variants. No smooth 3D rendering, no fuzzy edges. The source images are design references, not backgrounds to keep. Plant sprites must contain NO ground tile, no soil mound, no grass base, no pot, no cast shadow; all surrounding space and spaces between stems/leaves are transparent. Whole sprite uncropped with transparent margins. Maintain identity with approved sample02. This is a production SOURCE to be mechanically trimmed/placed in exact logical canvas, so generous outer transparent margin is fine. Do not add new botanical details or change species.
REQUESTED SPRITE: Extract ONLY one plain grass terrain tile like the upper-left diamond in image1. Isometric top diamond64 logical pixels wide by32 high, depth8 logical pixels, total content64x40. Two exposed shallow brown soil sides below front edges to form solid slab. Keep top plane geometric and straight 2:1 edges, not scalloped or wavy. No heavy dark border on TOP plane or bevel, so copies can meet seamlessly; darker outer silhouette belongs to soil sides only. One tile only.
